    8. For each pair of strings `(S[i], S[j])`, calculates the maximum overlap length `l` using rolling hashes and stores it in `E[i][j]`.
    9. Initializes a 2D long array `dp` for dynamic programming, with dimensions `[1 << N][N]`.
    10. Iterates over all subsets of strings and updates `dp` based on the overlap lengths stored in `E`.
    11. Calculates the total length `sum` of all strings in `S`.
    12. Initializes `ans` with a large constant `infL`.
    13. Updates `ans` to the minimum value of `sum - dp[(1 << N) - 1][i]` for each `i`.
    14. Returns `ans` as the final result.
